content: Jesu Yoiyeta eyi noku Lukulula

Cwale Jesu sebeli osiya esibaka eso ni kuta mu naha no Judeya ni kuta mu linjaliya ya Jodan. mi aanu no kupula sebeli aiya okuungana kwa yonyene kame, mi sebeli otangisa okwaiyeta, kakuli neli omukwa waye.
Cwwale Afalisi anjili sebeli aiya kwa yonyene okumweteka oku mwibanguta nji, “Kana kame kufanena nji omulume alukulule omukataye?”
Cwale Jesu sebeli waatambula nji, “Ngasibine omo ana ku milaelela Mushe?”
Cwale sebeli atambula nji, “Mushe kame anaku pumenena omulume nji on̄olele mukataye elin̄olo no tukuluho ni kumulukulula nji akutele.”
Kono Jesu sebeli waambela nji, “Mushe naku min̄olela omulawo owo kakuli emicima yenu niyaku bambaba oyi.
Kono ku matatekelo no kumbiwa elitunga, “Nyambe sebeli oumba omulume ni mukati.’
‘Mu libakaelyo mulume kame sasiye inawaye ni sitaye ni kwikala ni mukataye,
mi aanu awo ayili kame satende olutu lumweya.’ Abo kasa tinyutu timbili kono sebeli lutu lumweya.
Cwale eso ana beeke Nyambe bamweya, mulese oku pumenena omunu okusitaba.”
Cwale Jesu na iyetwa aye ali mu ndoo, sebeli amwibanguta kame etaba eyo.
Mi sebeli waambela nji, “Woyo yonje so lukulula omoyo waye ni kukwata mundina kame alwisa moyo waye mu kubuka.
Simba nji omukati okukana mbumwaye nji akwaliwe kundina kame abuka.”
Jesu Yofuyola Anuke Anyonyo
Cwale aanu sebeli alita anukana kwa Jesu nji aafuyaule, kono aiyetwa sebeli aayuta.
Cwale Jesu abana mona ngeeso, sebeli otina ni kwamba kwa onyene nji, “Komulesele anuke anyonyo aiye kwa mene, kakuli omubuso wa Nyambe niwoo.
Niti luli kame nimyambela nji, omunu yonje nji katambula omubuso wa Nyambe kanyi mwanuke, katamba okuwingena.”
Mi Jesu sebeli waashimba nikwabeeka ba maoko mane ni kwafuyaula okubeeka amaoko aye beulu yoo.
Omulume no Kufuma

Cwale Jesu abana tateka okwenda omwendo waye, sebeli kwiiya omulume yoitukela kway onyene ni kukwela ku makondo aye okukubama balubala lwaye ni kumwibanguta nji, “Weene omwiyeti no kuwaba, ngasibine sa nitende nji ni kawane omooyo no kwaabwa?”
Cwale Jesu sebeli otambula nji, “Iikene oniisanena nji mbili wa kuwaba? Kakwisa uyu no kuwaba konji Nyambe yomboci.
Olimukile emilawo, olese kwibaa , olese kubuka, olese kwiita, olese okupaka einu no mapwa, olese okoonga omukowe nji omubyangule esinu saye mi cwale okuteke inaowe ni sitowe.
Omulume woyo sebeli otambula nji, “Mwiyeti, eyi yonje kame nii mamele okutunda ku undumbana wange.”
Jesu sebeli omwaliketa niku musinga ni ku mwambela nji, “Kosili esinu simweya onasiyi. Cwale ote okaulise oufumu wowe wonje cwale otabele awo ashebile, mbuwana oufumu kuwilu mi cwale wiiye onikon̄e.”
Omulume abana yupa ngeeso, sebeli okomoka ni kweena onene kakuli kame ana kwikalanga ni ufumu no kupula.
Cwale Jesu sebeli waliketa oku noku ni kwamba kwa iyetwa aye nji, “Ngasibine kubambabile nji afumi aka ingene mu mubuso wa Nyambe!”
Cwale aiyetwa sebeli akomoka onene amaywi aye. Kono Jesu sebeli wamba kame nji, “Anaange, kame ku bambabile ngaibi nji awo asepile oufumu akaingene mu mubuso na ku wilu!
Kwakotoba ekamele okwingena mu litiyo no Ndonga okubita omunu no kufuma okwingena mu mubuso wa Nyambe.”
Aiyetwa aye sebeli akomoka onene, nuukwambota nji, “Cwale anyine so kayoisiwa?”
Jesu sebeli waaliketa ni kwamba nji, “Kwaanu kame ku pala, kono kwa Nyambe kame kutwesahala, einu yonje kame itwesahala kwa Nyambe.”
Cwale Pitolosi sebeli wamba kwa Jesu nji, “Omone, na tusiyi einu yetu yonje okukukon̄a.”
Jesu sebeli wamba nji, “Niti luli kame ni myambela, kakwisa omunu ona siyi endoo, simba amandaye, inawaye, sitaye, anaaye, amatema mulibaka lyange ni liywi no kuwaba,
woyo so kwangwa okutambula omwanda muno mu nako ino, etindoo, amandaye, inawaye, aana ni matema, niku yandisiwa mba tambula omooyo no kwabwa mu nako iiya.
Kono aanu no kupula no weli asaikale ku mamaneneno, anaku mamaneneno asa ikale ano weli.”
Jesu Yoamba eyi no Lufu Lyaye Aka no Waatu.

Cwale Jesu na iyetwa aye sebeli akambamena ku Jelusalema, Jesu yo twaletete aiyetwa aye ku lubala, mi aiyetwa sebeli akomoka okumona aanu awo ana ku mukon̄a acilile. Kame sebeli oshimbela ana kukwana likumi na yiili kunyonga ni kwaambela eyo saikatendahale kwa yonyene.

Jesu sebeli waambela nji, “Muteetete, kame tukambamena ku Jelusalema, Omwana no munu kame akabiwa mu maoko no apulisita akulu na iyeti no mulawo, mba mwatulele elifu ni ku mubeeke mu maata ano macaba,
mi awo kame samu shubaule ni ku musibwela amate, okumushapa ni ku mwibaa, mi munyima no maywaa aatu mba inguka kame.”
Okukumbela kwa Jakobo ni Jowani
Cwale Jakobo ni Jowani aana a Zebedia, sebeli aiya kwa Jesu ni ku mwambela nji, “Mwiyeti, kame tusinga nji otutendele eyo tukukumbela.”
Cwale Jesu sebeli waibanguta nji, “Iikene musinga nji nimi tendele?”
Sebeli amutambula nji, “Otupumenene nji aba so ikale mu kanya yowe, tukwikale omunjili nwaci ku silyo sowe omunjili ku simoo.”
Kono Jesu sebeli wamba kwa onyene nji, “Kamu limukile esi mu kumbela. Kame samutwese okunwena mu sinweno sani nwene? Simba oku kolobezwa ni kolobezo sani kolobeziwe?”
Cwale sebeli amutambula nji, “Kame tutwesa.” Mi Jesu sebeli wamba kwa onyene nji, “Kame sa mu nwene mu sinweno sa ni nwene, ni ku kolobeziwa ni kolobezo sa ni kolobeziwe,
kono okwikala ku lyoko lyange no silyo simba kweli no simoo, kasa mene sa nimiba, kono kame sa ku biwe kwawo ana lukisetwe ngeeso.”
Mi cwale aiyetwa no kukwana likumi aba ana kuyupa okukumbela oko, sebeli atinena Jakobo ni Jowani.
Cwale Jesu sebeli waaisana ni kwaambela nji, “Kame mulimukile nji aa aliketiwa nji ambumu no sicaba, kame atenda abika oo, mi akulu kame aendisa ni maata oo.
Kono kwaanyi kakutamba kwikala ngeeso, kono woyo yonje osinga okutenda omunene kwaanyi, atende omubika wenu,
mi omunu yonje mwaanyi woyo osinga okutenda uyu no weli, atende omubika wenu moonje.
Kakuli Omwana no munu kasiiyela nji abelekelwe, kono ninji abeleke mi abe omooyo waye nji aliulula aanu no kupula.”
Jesu Yobalisa Esibofu siisaniwa Batimeya
Cwale sebeli aiya mu Jeliko, mi Jesu abana tunda mu Jeliko na iyetwa aye, naanu no kupula, Batimeya omukumbeli no sibofu omwana Timeya, yo ikalile kunyonga no ndila.
Mi cwale abana kuyupa nji Jesu no Nazaleta, sebeli otangisa okukuwa nji, “Jesu, wene omwana Dabida, oni yupele amakeke.”
Mi aanu no kukupula sebeli amwayuta nji aondoke, kono sebeli okuwa onene nji, “Wene omwana Dabida oni yupele amakeke!”
Cwale Jesu sebeli oimana ni kwamba nji, “Mu mwisane.” Sebeli aisana esibofu nji, “O koongote, oimane, kame akwisana.”
Yonyene sebeli oyumba olwambi aye, ni kwimana ni makondo, mi sebeli oiya kwa Jesu.
Cwale Jesu sebeli omwambela nji, “Siikene osinga nji niku tendele?” Esibofu sebeli sitambula nji, “Molyange, ni biwe okumona.”
Cwale Jesu sebeli wamba kwa yonyene nji, “Ote, etumelo yowe naiku balisa.” Ababo sebeli obiwa okumona, mi sebeli okon̄a Jesu mu mukwakwa.
